question: In which year did the Government of India launch the National Youth Policy (NYP) to address the needs of India's youth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Government of India launched the **National Youth Policy (NYP) in 2014** to cater to the needs and aspirations of the youth in India.
 
• The policy focuses on individuals aged **15 to 29 years**, who make up around 27.5% of the population, highlighting its significance in national development.
 
• **NYP 2014** prioritizes areas such as education, skill development, employment, entrepreneurship, health, and sports to empower the youth.
 
• The policy aims to ensure **inclusive development** by addressing the needs of marginalized and disadvantaged youth and involving them in nation-building activities.
 
• Implementation is done through collaboration between various ministries, state governments, and private organizations, leveraging schemes like Skill India and Start-Up India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Objectives of NYP 2014:**

 
 
• To develop a productive and skilled workforce that can contribute to economic growth.
 
• To promote social values and community engagement among the youth.
 
• To ensure equitable access to resources and opportunities for youth, irrespective of their socioeconomic background.
 
• To encourage youth participation in governance, decision-making processes, and leadership roles.
 
 
 
• **Priority Areas under NYP 2014:**
 
 
• **Education:** Focus on providing universal access to quality education and vocational training.
 
• **Skill Development:** Emphasis on improving employability through skill-building programs.
 
• **Employment & Entrepreneurship:** Creating opportunities for entrepreneurship and self-employment.
 
• **Health:** Addressing the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of the youth.
 
• **Sports:** Promoting competitive sports and physical fitness programs.
 
 
 
• **Implementation of NYP 2014:**
 
 
• The policy encourages collaboration with private organizations and industries.
 
• It integrates existing government initiatives like Start-Up India, Digital India, and Skill India for achieving its objectives.
